digest.component_or_area: file-impact state model and CLI dispatch
propositions: The current empty file_impact value conflates two distinct states (author forgot vs. no file touched); a tri-state model with explicit 'none' declaration is needed to disambiguate.

FILE_IMPACT event payload must gain file_impact_scope and no_file_impact_reason keys, with reducer derivation routing non-empty paths to 'paths', empty paths plus explicit none to 'none', and otherwise to 'undeclared'.

set-file-impact CLI command must move from fixed-arity _REGISTRY to variadic _ARGV_REGISTRY and support both JSON-array form (unchanged) and new --none form with reason validation (minimum 10 non-whitespace chars).
Library function get_file_impact_scope and MCP tool declare_no_file_impact must expose the tri-state and enforce the same reason validation as the CLI without silent write on validation failure.
State transitions between undeclared/paths/none must be mutually exclusive and last-writer-wins, with all paths cleared when transitioning to none and reason cleared when transitioning to paths.
